rows.name: Steakhouse Financial

steps: Day 0 · Verify Steakhouse Financial's issuer, token status and official app independently for Base; the frozen record contains no contracts or URLs. Check campaign terms and supported assets. Budget: $0; 20 minutes. No points or launch is confirmed.

Day 1 · If Steakhouse Financial exposes an eligible public vault on Base, deposit $20 of a supported asset, test redemption, then build the position to at most $200. For a curator, verify the vault's manager; do not assume it has its own deposit app. Assumed capital ceiling: $200; this is a test budget, not a protocol minimum. Allow 25 minutes.

Setup and exit · Reserve $12 total for gas on Base, plus $0 for trading fees/slippage where relevant. These are assumed ceilings, not measured quotes. Inspect each quote and stop if the total exceeds $12; 10 minutes.

Days 2–30 · Keep only a successfully tested position for 30 days; review balance, access and exit liquidity once a week (10 minutes). Do not repeat paid actions unless published rules require them; research-only routes remain unfunded.

Day 30 · If funded, redeem the test position using the verified app and revoke unused approvals where supported. Record chain, wallet, dates, transaction IDs, fees and any failed withdrawal. Budget exit gas within the $12 reserve; 15 minutes.

If a launch is announced · Re-check issuer and eligibility before any claim; record vesting and circulating supply. Assume zero entitlement until published terms prove it. Do not fund an unknown claim contract. Budget $0 until terms are known; 15 minutes.
farm_plan.risk: Vault loss, manager risk and exit liquidity

Day 1 · If Symbiotic offers a public supply market on Ethereum, supply $20 of a listed asset, redeem the test, then build supply to at most $200. For CDPs use a collateral deposit only if supported; do not borrow or assume USDC support. Assumed capital ceiling: $200; this is a test budget, not a protocol minimum. Allow 25 minutes.

Setup and exit · Reserve $40 total for gas on Ethereum, plus $0 for trading fees/slippage where relevant. These are assumed ceilings, not measured quotes. Inspect each quote and stop if the total exceeds $40; 10 minutes.

Days 2–30 · Keep only a successfully tested position for 30 days; review balance, access and exit liquidity once a week (10 minutes). Do not repeat paid actions unless published rules require them; research-only routes remain unfunded.

Day 30 · If funded, redeem the test position using the verified app and revoke unused approvals where supported. Record chain, wallet, dates, transaction IDs, fees and any failed withdrawal. Budget exit gas within the $40 reserve; 15 minutes.

If a launch is announced · Re-check issuer and eligibility before any claim; record vesting and circulating supply. Assume zero entitlement until published terms prove it. Do not fund an unknown claim contract. Budget $0 until terms are known; 15 minutes.
